summary_en: TOLI Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 1.1 million shares (1.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 880 million yen through November 4 to December 28, 2026, using block trades and market purchases to enhance capital efficiency under the medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
TOLI Corporation's board of directors approved on November 2, 2026 the acquisition of up to 1.1 million shares of its common stock, representing 1.9% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total consideration of 880 million yen. The acquisition will be conducted from November 4 through December 28, 2026 using block trades (ToSTNeT-3) and market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The company positions this buyback within its medium-term management plan "SHINKA Plus ONE 2.0" announced in April 2025. The plan maintains a dividend policy targeting a consolidated payout ratio of 50% or DOE of 3.5%, with annual dividends set at a minimum of 19 yen per share. The buyback authorization complements this dividend commitment, with flexible treasury share acquisitions designed to achieve a total shareholder return ratio of 70% or more on a three-year average basis during the plan period.

Management stated the repurchase program aims to enhance enterprise value and capital efficiency through disciplined capital allocation aligned with the company's shareholder return framework.
